result.rationale: Ottawa ankle rule is positive: bony tenderness at the tip/posterior edge of the lateral malleolus warrants imaging to rule out fracture, even though the patient can bear weight four steps. No emergency red flags (no deformity, open wound, numbness, vascular compromise), so same-day asynchronous clinician assessment to arrange X-ray and advise RICE/protection is appropriate rather than self-care alone.
